purpose: closed-loop engineering diagnostic of the E2 checkpoint on frozen scenes

checkpoint.train_state_step_note: E3 evaluated the 100-update checkpoint (Orbax step 99, TrainState.step 100); the resumed TrainState.step 101 checkpoint is E2 recovery evidence, not the E3 subject

smoke.note: full short closed loop on a scene not used for training or evaluation tuning

invalid_rule.definition: policy server unreachable or no action produced before the first env.step
invalid_rule.handling: record invalid_infrastructure, retry the same frozen scene once, keep both attempts; if the retry also fails the scene is reported invalid and excluded from the 20-scene denominator with the denominator restated
invalid_rule.mid_episode_policy_error: counts as a failure in the denominator

actions.semantics: absolute joint targets, left six then right six
